fullContentHtml:
Railway RRB Group D CBT-I Exam Date 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs) has released CBT-I Exam Date for the recruitment of various Group D posts in Level 1 on the official website of the RRBs. This recruitment has been issued for 22,195 posts. The online registration process for Railway RRB Group D Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 31 January 2026, to 09 March 2026 (Extended). The CBT-I examination is going to conducted from 03-21 August 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for Railway RRB Group D CBT-I Exam Date 2026 given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 30 January 2026
  • Application Start Date : 31 January 2026
  • Last Date : 09 March 2026 (Extend)
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 11 March 2026
  • Correction Date : 12 to 21 March 2026
  • Exam Date : 03-21 August 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-
  • Fee Refund (After Appearing in Stage I Exam)
  • General : Rs. 400/-
  • OBC, EWS, SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is Railway RRB Group D CBT-I Exam Date 2026?

Railway RRB Group D CBT-I Exam Date 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date to apply is 09 March 2026 (Extend).

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://indianrailways.gov.in/

How to download notification?

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
